name: codex-discord-channel
description: Stable instance-scoped Discord delivery for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Bind Discord to a stable Codex instance boundary.
interface.longDescription: An instance-scoped Discord channel plugin for Codex. It authenticates local runtime generations by stable account and state bindings, and persistently queues accepted inbound messages until delivery can be verified without unsafe terminal keystrokes.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-discord-channel to check Discord channel status.
